title: Named code block spans
responsibility: Finds named top-level functions and class methods in masked JavaScript or TypeScript source.

inputs.name: blockSpans.masked
inputs.description: JavaScript or TypeScript text with non-code contents masked while preserving offsets and grouping punctuation.

outputs.name: blockSpans
outputs.description: Spans sorted by start offset, each naming a function or Class.method with its kind and source bounds. Supported declarations and assigned function values are included; unrecognized or incomplete bodies are omitted.
